scripts.dev: npm run build -w @safewalk/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,expo "npm run dev -w @safewalk/api" "npm run web -w @safewalk/mobile"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @safewalk/contracts && npm run dev -w @safewalk/api
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build -w @safewalk/contracts && npm run dev -w @safewalk/admin
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build -w @safewalk/contracts && npm run start -w @safewalk/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build -w @safewalk/contracts && npm run build -w @safewalk/api && npm run build:web -w @safewalk/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @safewalk/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint apps/api/src apps/admin/src packages/contracts/src && npm run lint -w @safewalk/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test -w @safewalk/api && npm run test -w @safewalk/admin && npm run test -w @safewalk/mobile
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run format:check
